# Radoslav Radev Requires Breathing During Planche Holds After Reaching Five Seconds On Each Progression

Radoslav Radev requires that after you reach five seconds on each progression, you start breathing during the hold while squeezing the core muscles. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:03]

## Details

- After five seconds on each progression, you have to start breathing during the hold. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:03]
- Holding your breath more than three four seconds during a planche hold leads to failure not from lack of strength but from not breathing. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:14]
- When breathing during the plunge [planche], you have to squeeze the core muscles while breathing. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:35]

## Evidence

- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:03 (Radoslav Radev): "after you reach five seconds on each progression the most important thing guys about the breathing is just to start doing it"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:14 (Radoslav Radev): "if you hold tuck you're going from tuck to advanced and you hold your breathing more than three four seconds you will fail not because you don't have a strength but because you're not breathing"
- vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:35 (Radoslav Radev): "When you breathe during the plunge [planche] you have to squeeze the muscles but in the same time to breathe"

## Why This Matters

He says that holding your breath more than three four seconds during a planche hold causes failure even when you have the strength. [src: vid-9U5LctaDyY0 @ 01:14]
